NEOW.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_GU: [sine]Go forth... and refine what the Spire gives you...[/sine]
DARV.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_GU: There is still much to refine.
Excellent! Then take something useful and make it yours!
OROBAS.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_: All things beneath heaven can be turned to my use.
Then choose the gift that serves you best.
PAEL.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_GU: When opportunity arrives, it should be taken.
Good. Let us see how you use this opportunity.
TANX.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_GU: I will judge the price against the reward myself.
TEZCATARA.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_: Whatever the truth may be, I will use it to advance.
Interesting... may you endure everything you are about to see.
VAKUU.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_LU_G: Power has no virtue of its own. Only its wielder matters.
Then prove that you are worthy of this power.
NONUPEIPE.talk.LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CHARACTER_: Fate is unreliable. Only one's own strength can be trusted.
Heh... then let us see what fate offers you this time.
